issues.description: Constructor parameter mismatch for Meal: the problem statement (UML) and the solution expect Meal(String name, String[] ingredients), but the template declares the constructor as Meal(String[] ingredients, String name). This also conflicts with the example usage in the template Main (which calls new Meal("cowBoyStew", new String[]{...})). This inconsistency will confuse students and can cause compilation or runtime errors when they try to use the example code or follow the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the Meal constructor in the template to match the specification and solution: public Meal(String name, String[] ingredients). Update any template example usages if needed. Alternatively, if the reversed parameter order was intended, update the problem statement and solution usage examples to match, but aligning the template to the problem/spec is recommended.
